description: Presentations on Wireless security at DEF CON 23 covers point-to-point radio proxying, distributed 802.11 spectrum monitoring, and Software-Defined Radio tradecraft.

talks.title: HamSammich - Long Distance Proxying Over Radio
talks.teaser: Robert Graham and David Maynor demonstrate HamSammich, a low-cost long-distance 900MHz point-to-point radio link to proxy Wi-Fi connections and conceal physical location.

talks.title: 802.11 Massive Monitoring
talks.teaser: Andrés Blanco and Andrés Gazzoli present an OpenWrt-based distributed capture architecture to simultaneously monitor and inject frames across all 802.11 channels.
